es: Reconocer cuándo una decisión pasada explica una situación presente con condicionales mixtos (If I had…, I would… now).

teaching.en: If I had accepted the offer, I would be living abroad now.
teaching.es: Si hubiera aceptado la oferta, ahora estaría viviendo en el extranjero.
teaching.explanationEs: If + had + participio mira al pasado; would + verbo base, al presente.
segments: If I had accepted the offer,
I would be living abroad now.
teaching.audioText: If I had accepted the offer, I would be living abroad now.

teaching.en: If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor today.
teaching.es: Si hubiera estudiado medicina, hoy sería médica.
teaching.explanationEs: Today marca el resultado en el presente.
segments: If she had studied medicine, she
teaching.audioText: If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor today.

teaching.en: If they hadn't made that decision, they wouldn't have this career now.
teaching.es: Si no hubieran tomado esa decisión, ahora no tendrían esta carrera.
teaching.explanationEs: La negativa usa hadn't en la condición y wouldn't en el resultado.
segments: If they hadn't made that decision,
they wouldn't have this career now.
teaching.audioText: If they hadn't made that decision, they wouldn't have this career now.

teaching.en: If Leo had finished his degree, he would have a better job now.
teaching.es: Si Leo hubiera terminado su carrera, ahora tendría un mejor trabajo.
teaching.explanationEs: Would have a better job now: would + verbo base, sin participio.
segments: If Leo had finished his degree, he
would have a better job now.
teaching.audioText: If Leo had finished his degree, he would have a better job now.

teaching.en: If you had listened to my advice, you wouldn't regret it now.
teaching.es: Si hubieras escuchado mi consejo, ahora no te arrepentirías.
teaching.explanationEs: El efecto actual (regret) va en presente con would.
segments: If you had listened to my
advice, you wouldn't regret it now.
teaching.audioText: If you had listened to my advice, you wouldn't regret it now.

teaching.en: If Ana hadn't moved abroad, she would be working in her father's shop instead.
teaching.es: Si Ana no se hubiera ido al extranjero, estaría trabajando en la tienda de su padre.
teaching.explanationEs: Instead = «en su lugar»: la alternativa que no ocurrió.
segments: If Ana hadn't moved abroad, she would
be working in her father's shop instead.
teaching.audioText: If Ana hadn't moved abroad, she would be working in her father's shop instead.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une la decisión pasada de Sam con su situación actual.

choices.text: If Sam takes the job, he will live in Paris.
If Sam had taken the job, he would live in Paris now.
If Sam took the job, he would have lived in Paris.

feedback.es: La decisión es pasada (no tomó el trabajo) y el efecto es actual: If + had + participio, would + verbo base + now.

hint.es: Busca had + participio en la condición y would + verbo base en el resultado.

origin.text: Sam did not take the job in Paris. Today he lives in a small town.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si hubiera estudiado más, ahora tendría un mejor trabajo.»

feedback.es: La condición mira al pasado irreal, así que lleva had + participio: If I had studied.

hint.es: Es el auxiliar que va delante del participio en la condición.

origin.text: If I ___ studied more, I would have a better job now.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si hubiera aceptado la oferta, ahora viviría en el extranjero.»

answer.text: If I had accepted the offer, I would live abroad now.

feedback.es: Primero la condición pasada con coma; después el resultado presente con would.

hint.es: La condición va primero, con coma; el resultado acaba con now.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada condicional con la situación real que explica.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuál es la situación real del hablante hoy.

choices.text: He learned to swim as a child.
He can't swim, so he is afraid of the sea.

feedback.es: If I had learned… would not be afraid: no aprendió, y por eso hoy tiene miedo del mar.

origin.audio: If I had learned to swim as a child, I would not be afraid of the sea now.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no hubiera conocido a Leo, ahora no estaría aquí.»

feedback.es: En la negativa, el resultado presente lleva wouldn't + verbo base: I wouldn't be here.

origin.text: If I hadn't met Leo, I ___ be here now.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une la decisión pasada de Tom con su situación actual.

choices.text: If Tom had finished his studies, he would have a better job now.
If Tom finishes his studies, he will have a better job.
If Tom had finished his studies, he would have had a better job.

feedback.es: No terminó la carrera (pasado) y hoy trabaja en una tienda (presente): had + participio y would + verbo base con now.

origin.text: Tom did not finish his studies. Now he works in a shop.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la frase que explica la situación actual de Ana.

choices.text: If Ana misses the bus, she will be at home.
If Ana hadn't missed the bus, she would be at work now.
If Ana had missed the bus, she would be at work now.

feedback.es: Perdió el bus (pasado) y sigue en casa (presente): si no lo hubiera perdido, estaría en el trabajo.

origin.audio: Ana missed the bus this morning, so she is still at home.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no hubiera terminado la carrera universitaria, no tendría este trabajo.»

feedback.es: Degree es el título universitario; la condición pasada explica el trabajo de hoy.

origin.text: If she hadn't finished her ___, she wouldn't have this job now.

prompt.es: Escribe la condicional que une el consejo ignorado con su efecto actual.

answer.text: If Ana had listened to her brother's advice, she wouldn't regret it now.
accepted: If Ana had listened to her brother's advice, she wouldn't regret it now.
If Ana had listened to her brother, she wouldn't regret it now.

feedback.es: No escuchó (pasado) y se arrepiente (presente): If + had listened, would + verbo base + now.

origin.text: Hechos: Ana no escuchó el consejo de su hermano. Hoy se arrepiente.

prompt.es: Mia cometió un error típico: ¿cuál es la frase correcta?

choices.text: If I would stay in school, I would have a better job now.
If I had stayed in school, I would have had a better job now.
If I had stayed in school, I would have a better job now.

feedback.es: Tras if va had + participio, y el resultado de hoy lleva would + verbo base: would have had no encaja con now.

origin.text: Mia says: If I would have stayed in school, I would have a better job now.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si hubieran seguido mi consejo, ahora no se arrepentirían.»

answer.text: If they had followed my advice, they wouldn't regret it now.

feedback.es: La condición pasada (had followed) explica el presente (wouldn't regret).

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no se hubiera roto la pierna, hoy estaría jugando la final.»

feedback.es: Today marca un resultado presente: por eso se usa would be playing y no would have played.

origin.text: If he hadn't broken his leg, he would be playing in the final ___.
